column1: # Optional hostile Ash Jenna confrontation after Venus Lighthouse. She is the evil Jenna from the sprite animation: unrepentant, dangerous, not redeemed. The original game ending remains unchanged.

column3: You survived.\nI wondered whether\nyou'd come back.{end_wait}
The lighthouse broke.\n{actor_name:7} fell. {actor_name:5}\njumped after her.{end_wait}
And you couldn't\ncatch either of them.\nThat must hurt.{end_wait}
We don't know\nwhat happened below.\nWe're going to look.{end_wait}
You'll search the sea\nwithout even knowing\nwhether they live.{end_wait}
They deserve a search.\nEven if we find\nnothing.{end_wait}
The coast broke open.\nI watched the ruin spread.\nI wanted more.{end_wait}

In my world, the
beacons burned too.{page_break}The Wise One let
our world die.
I watched it happen.{end_wait}
You still don't know\nwhat destroyed\nyour world.{end_wait}
I don't need proof.\nI need him to suffer.\nThat is the difference.{end_wait}
I agreed to help\nfind the truth.{page_break}I never agreed\nto your revenge.{end_wait}
I refused you then.\nI heard your answer.{page_break}Nothing I've seen\nhas changed my mind.{end_wait}
Your {actor_name:6} and Kraden\nare still missing.\nGo on. Run after them.{end_wait}
And Felix and Sheba.\nThey're not names\nI can just forget.{end_wait}
You count every name.{page_break}I'd leave this town\nto burn for one\nchance at him.{end_wait}
These people did\nnothing to you.\nLeave them out of this.{end_wait}
And when you must\nchoose, {actor_name:1},{page_break}who will you\nleave behind?{end_wait}
I may have to choose.\nBut you don't get\nto decide who matters.{end_wait}
